analysis: The code snippet calls f.exists() inside an if condition. The File object f is a parameter to the method load(). There is no prior validation or check for security manager permissions before calling exists. The exists method may throw SecurityException if a security manager exists and denies read access. No try-catch block surrounds the exists call, so the exception is not handled locally and would propagate up. Therefore, the SecurityException is not avoided.
remark: The SecurityException is triggered when a security manager is installed and its checkRead method denies read access to the file denoted by the abstract pathname f. In the given context, there is no check to prevent this scenario, so if the security manager denies access, the exception will be thrown.
